Definition: to secrete, by act or word; hence (intensively) to destroy
BiblicalUsage: 1) to hide, conceal, cut off, cut down, make desolate, kick; 1a) (Niphal); 1a1) to be hidden; 1a2) to be effaced, be destroyed, be cut off; 1b) (Piel) to cover, hide; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to hide; 1c2) to efface, annihilate
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
